mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generation_job (stage_id, mode, current_plan_index, total, status, phase, last_error) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{mode}, #{currentPlanIndex}, #{total}, #{status}, #{phase}, #{lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT id, stage_id, mode, current_plan_index, total, status, phase, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM generation_job WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, stage_id, mode, current_plan_index, total, status, phase, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM generation_job WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_job SET mode = #{mode}, current_plan_index = #{currentPlanIndex}, total = #{total}, status = #{status}, phase = #{phase}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
